about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Kelly Morrison

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FAILING ECONOMIC POLICIES
statements.title: FAILING ECONOMIC POLICIES
sentences: President Trump's tariffs have cost Minnesotans alone $4.8 billion, and for what?

This will be a disaster for our small businesses, farmers, and every Minnesotan who is going to have to pay higher prices because of tariffs on everything from steel to kitchen appliances to hockey sticks.
If Trump won't end this trade war, Congress has to.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: END THE WAR IN IRAN
statements.title: END THE WAR IN IRAN
sentences: Madam Speaker, today, I rise against the Trump administration's reckless, costly, and illegal war in Iran.
President Trump has informed the Nation that we are, once again, at war with Iran, an illegal war that no one asked for, no one wanted, and yet every American is paying the price for.
Food, housing, and childcare costs are astronomical.
Now, he is demanding that taxpayers pay hundreds of billions of dollars to fund his new endless, costly, illegal war in Iran.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL GUN VIOLENCE AWARENESS MONTH
statements.title: NATIONAL GUN VIOLENCE AWARENESS MONTH
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in recognition of June as National Gun Violence Awareness Month.
We need to ban assault weapons, bump stocks, and high-capacity magazine sales, get weapons of war off of our streets, invest in addressing our Nation's mental health crisis, and the list goes on.
Gun violence is an epidemic that has stained our country, and we are going in the wrong direction.

As our country faces hundreds of mass shootings every year, more mass shootings than any country on the face of the planet, the Trump administration is taking an ax to our Nation's gun safety laws and doing the dirty work of the big gun lobby, rolling back dozens of Federal safety regulations, making it easier for criminals to buy and ship guns, cutting funding, and abandoning critical gun violence prevention programs that keep our communities safe.
We could create a world with far less gun violence, where people don't live in fear of it, if only Congress had the courage to act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS 2ND AMENDMENT PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: VETERANS 2ND AMENDMENT PROTECTION ACT
sentences: According to the National Alliance on Mental Illness, 46 percent of people who die by suicide suffered from a known mental health condition.

As public health and suicide prevention experts will tell you, Mr. Speaker, putting time and distance between a firearm and a person experiencing a mental health crisis is essential to preventing a successful suicide attempt.
Preventing VA from reporting to the NICS background check system risks putting more firearms in the hands of a population of veterans who are already at an increased risk of death by suicide.

Instead of considering this partisan legislation that puts more veterans at risk, we should be working together to advance solutions that will help us fight veteran suicide, like improving access to timely mental health care, protecting crisis intervention resources such as the Veterans Crisis Line, and ensuring VA has the resources and staffing it needs to give our veterans the outstanding care they deserve.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to H.R. 1041, legislation that would prevent VA from keeping firearms out of the hands of some of the most vulnerable veterans in the VA system.
H.R. 1041 creates serious risks for a group of veterans who are already in a vulnerable position, and I cannot support it.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HIGHLIGHTING WOMEN'S HEALTH
statements.title: HIGHLIGHTING WOMEN'S HEALTH
sentences: Supporting Ukraine Mr. Speaker, this past Sunday, millions celebrated the work, love, and support mothers give to their children and families across the country.

Growing scientific progress and an expanding focus on women's health opened doors for the organization to serve as a leading voice as the Nation experienced historic advances, like the FDA's approval of the birth control pill and the Griswold v. Connecticut decision that established the right to privacy and, therefore, the right to use contraception, which had been illegal in Connecticut and many other States prior to this decision in 1965.

The landmark Roe v. Wade decision, as well as the establishment of the Title X program, which was the first Federal grant program in the United States dedicated to providing family planning and other preventive health services to low-income families, both elevated women's health further and supported ACOG's efforts to expand access to reproductive healthcare to all Americans, regardless of their ability to pay.

From the critical influence of the Doe v. Bolton decision, which was the companion case to Roe v. Wade in which the Supreme Court struck down burdensome procedural requirements that effectively made abortion completely inaccessible in Georgia, even if the patient's life or health were threatened, to the mobilization needed in the aftermath of the Dobbs decision in 2022, which overturned Roe.

Both turn to ACOG for information about critical topics, ranging from contraception, cancer screening, STI screening and treatment, obstetric care, best surgical practices and advances, nutrition, abortion care, vaccines, menopause care, and everything in between.

During times of transformational advancements like the development and approval of the HPV vaccine, the Affordable Care Act, and historic investments in maternal death prevention efforts, ACOG has led and helped expand key collaborations and partnerships.

During the COVID-19 pandemic and in the wake of the Dobbs decision, ACOG held strong to the foundational mission that has driven its work for decades, strengthening equitable, accessible obstetric and gynecologic care.

In the wealthiest country in the world, in a country built on the principles of human dignity and freedom, these alarming statistics can and should lead to a unified bipartisan effort to address them.

Beyond navigating increasing administrative burdens, burnout, and workforce instability, OB/GYNs are having to deal with health and medical misinformation jeopardizing their work and their patients' well-being.
Patients are increasingly exposed to misinformation about contraception, fertility, pregnancy care, menopause, vaccines, and reproductive health.

From championing expanding Medicaid coverage to 12-months postpartum in Minnesota to advocating for the reauthorization of the Newborn Screening Saves Lives Act in Congress, I have advocated for advancing early intervention and prevention to save lives.

In the decades I have spent in this remarkable profession, it has been my sincere honor and privilege to provide the care my patients needed, from prenatal care through labor and delivery, to contraception, to hormone replacement therapy, from the exam room to the operating room, helping patients through important life stage transitions, creating care plans through shared decisionmaking, always working to meet patients where they are to meet their unique needs.
Younger generations of Americans and even some older Americans may not be able to recall a United States without protected access to birth control or an HPV vaccine.
I am remembering my patients who disclosed, in some cases for the first time in their life, their traumatic experiences prior to the protections of Roe v. Wade.
I am thinking of my younger patients who worried about the possibility of losing protected access to abortion care as the Supreme Court ruled on the Dobbs case.
Its safety record surpasses most over-the-counter medicines.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONGRESS' BETRAYAL OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE
statements.title: CONGRESS' BETRAYAL OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE
sentences: The same week we learned that the Trump administration spent more than $11.3 billion on the first 6 days of the war in Iran alone, a survey found that one in three Americans are skipping meals, rationing medications, and delaying buying a home or having children because of the cost of healthcare in this country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
sentences: After spending the last few weeks threatening access to childcare support and doing literally nothing to help millions of Americans afford their healthcare, Republicans want to direct taxpayer dollars away from helping families afford necessities like food, rent, and childcare to crisis pregnancy centers that prey on vulnerable women seeking legitimate reproductive healthcare.
They serve the anti-abortion agenda.

At a time when our country has a shameful maternal and infant mortality crisis and is facing a worsening shortage of obstetricians, the so-called pro-life movement is focused not on helping women or supporting their families or delivering the IVF coverage the President promised; they are focused on denying women their reproductive rights and failing to deliver for American families.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to H.R. 6945.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to stand for women and families, for dignity and for freedom, and vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT RELATING TO PUBLIC LAND ORDER NO. 7917 FOR WITHDRAWAL OF FEDERAL LAND
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT RELATING TO PUBLIC LAND ORDER NO. 7917 FOR WITHDRAWAL OF FEDERAL LANDS; COOK, LAKE, AND SAINT LOUIS...
sentences: Antofagasta, owned by a Chilean billionaire who is a crony of President Trump's, is the foreign mining company that wants to extract minerals from this watery wilderness.

Allowing a Chilean mining company to extract copper from our public lands, destroy the Boundary Waters, and send minerals to benefit billionaire owners and China will not protect our national security.
Mr. Speaker, today I rise in strong opposition to H.J. Res. 140.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNAFFORDABLE HEALTH CARE COSTS
statements.title: UNAFFORDABLE HEALTH CARE COSTS
sentences: Americans are being forced into crushing medical debt, are in danger of losing their closest hospital, clinic, or emergency room.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS' COMPENSATION COST-OF-LIVING ADJUSTMENT ACT OF 2025
statements.title: VETERANS' COMPENSATION COST-OF-LIVING ADJUSTMENT ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of S. 2392, the Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: A LETTER FROM SURVIVORS OF JEFFREY EPSTEIN AND GHISLAINE MAXWELL
statements.title: A LETTER FROM SURVIVORS OF JEFFREY EPSTEIN AND GHISLAINE MAXWELL
sentences: Mr. Speaker, today I rise to read a letter from more than 20 survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.
Strong American women are serving in the House of Representatives, and survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell's abuse need you to stand with them.
Jeffrey Epstein abused hundreds of women.
Any other American man would have been imprisoned for life, yet Epstein was not.
We implore you to stop protecting those who enabled Epstein's crimes and instead stand firm in protecting the women and children he harmed.
The rich and powerful should answer for their crimes the same way that everyone else does.
No one should live above the law.

First, we ask that you vote in favor of the Epstein transparency act and that you help us ensure with its passing that the identities of survivors are protected and the identities of the perpetrators or enablers are not.
Signed by more than 20 survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell. ____________________
We stand together in pain and resilience, and we are asking for your help.
We will tell you why we matter.
We will tell you why this matters.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MODERNIZING ALL VETERANS AND SURVIVORS CLAIMS PROCESSING ACT
statements.title: MODERNIZING ALL VETERANS AND SURVIVORS CLAIMS PROCESSING ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 3854, the Modernizing All Veterans and Survivors Claims Processing Act.
Mr. Speaker, I will end by thanking the gentleman from North Carolina (Mr. Edwards) for his partnership and the chair and ranking member for their support.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING THE ATTACKS ON MINNESOTA LAWMAKERS IN BROOKLYN PARK AND CHAMPLIN, MINNESOTA, AND CALLING FOR UNITY AND THE REJECTION OF POLITICAL VIOLENCE IN MINNESOTA A
statements.title: CONDEMNING THE ATTACKS ON MINNESOTA LAWMAKERS IN BROOKLYN PARK AND CHAMPLIN, MINNESOTA, AND CALLING FOR UNITY AND THE REJECTION OF POLITICAL VIOLENCE IN MINNESOTA AND ACROSS THE UNITED STATES
sentences: There have been assassination attempts, kidnapping plots, arson, and insurrection.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CAPPING EXCESSIVE AWARDING OF SBLC ENTRANTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: CAPPING EXCESSIVE AWARDING OF SBLC ENTRANTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Right now, small businesses across the country are ringing the alarm bells saying that the tariff wars are going to put them out of business in a matter of weeks or months.

These are successful small businesses, small businesses that were thriving, growing, expanding until President Trump started this completely unnecessary, completely chaotic trade war by setting exorbitant tariffs as high as 145 percent, changing policies haphazardly, at times literally by the hour.
President Trump's so-called tariff policy is literally killing our small businesses.
Article I of the Constitution says Congress has the power to levy tariffs, but what is the Republican majority doing?

They are ceding all their power to this President and completely disregarding their constitutional duty and the outcries from small business owners who are warning us they will have to close their doors in a matter of weeks if this tariff war doesn't end.

Mr. Speaker, the three bills the Republicans are choosing to bring to the floor this week have nothing to do with the existential threat that these tariffs are posing to our Nation's small businesses.
We should be passing legislation to end this tariff war and save our small businesses.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BOUNDARY WATERS CANOE AREA WILDERNESS
statements.title: BOUNDARY WATERS CANOE AREA WILDERNESS
sentences: My husband and I take our kids camping and paddling in the Boundary Waters every year, and we are not alone.
Mr. Speaker, today I rise in opposition to a provision tucked away in the Republican's budget proposal that will open up the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness to toxic sulfide-ore copper mining.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
sentences: They simply cannot afford the care that she needs without Medicaid.
Medicaid is what allows Alicia's daughter to go to school, to regain her motor skills, and to run a 5K with her classmates, something unthinkable before her treatment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS EVERYONE
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS EVERYONE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today alongside my colleagues in the Democratic Doctors Caucus and as the first and only pro-choice OB/GYN here in Congress to speak out against the Republicans' disastrous budget proposal and to fight for our women, children, and families.
I think about all of the babies I have delivered whose moms got their healthcare through Medicaid and how critical that was to help them get off to the best possible start.

It is because of those patients and patients all across the country that I stand here today both incredulous and outraged that the Republican majority in Congress is shoving a budget through that will gut Medicaid, the very health insurance program that covers 40 percent of all births and insures almost half of all children in our country.
Let's look at the facts about that maternal healthcare crisis that we face now and remember that this is before we gut Medicaid.
In 2022, there were more than double and sometimes triple the rate of maternal deaths in the United States compared to most other high-income countries, and unacceptable disparities exist.
Black, American-Indian, and Alaska-Native women are three to four times more likely to die from a pregnancy-related cause compared to White women.

To make the math work to cut taxes for billionaires, they are choosing to sell out the health of women, moms, new babies, and the future of our country to pay for tax cuts for billionaires, choosing to take healthcare away from moms and their babies.
This won't just be devastating to the moms and new babies who get their healthcare coverage through Medicaid.
All of this is coming from the party that calls itself pro-life and profamily.
The Republican majority needs to make their profamily rhetoric match their policy, put America's moms and babies first, and stop these proposed cuts to Medicaid.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELIMINATING HEAD START
statements.title: ELIMINATING HEAD START
sentences: Let me tell you, eliminating early childhood care and education, making our Nation's childcare crisis even worse and taking away parents' ability to go to work and provide for their families, is not how you persuade women to have more children.
On top of that, gutting Medicaid, the health insurance program that covers half of all children and 40 percent of all births, is not how you persuade women to have more children.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADDRESSING UNWORKABLE FUNDING REDUCTIONS IN THE FEDERAL BUDGET
statements.title: ADDRESSING UNWORKABLE FUNDING REDUCTIONS IN THE FEDERAL BUDGET
sentences: Republicans in State legislatures do not want to gut Medicaid.
Minnesotans do not want to gut Medicaid.
Americans do not want to gut Medicaid.
So why in the world are congressional Republicans teeing up these massive cuts to Medicaid in their budget?
It is because they are singularly focused on giving massive tax breaks to their wealthy donors, to billionaires like Elon Musk, and to huge corporations.
You cannot hide from the fact that you are choosing to decimate State budgets in order to serve your donors and your billionaire elites.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING AMERICAN FAMILIES
statements.title: PROTECTING AMERICAN FAMILIES
sentences: Last week, I met with Minnesota families and childcare providers to talk about how expensive it is to raise a family and care for young children.
With this administration's sweeping tariffs, families will be forced to pay even more for the products they need to care for their children such as high chairs, cribs, strollers, and car seats.
That is why today my Democratic colleagues and I are calling on the administration to exempt essential childcare products from these tariffs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILLIONS DEPEND ON SOCIAL SECURITY
statements.title: MILLIONS DEPEND ON SOCIAL SECURITY
sentences: Last week, Trump's billionaire Commerce Secretary was speaking with another billionaire about how only fraudsters would complain about missing a Social Security check.
Trump's billionaire Commerce Secretary said that if Social Security didn't send out checks for a month, his mother-in-law simply would not call to complain.

At the very same time, I held a townhall with my constituents where Jeff and Bev, from Bloomington, asked this question: If or when Trump ends Social Security, Bev and I will be unable to pay our mortgage.
We will become homeless at age 70.

On their behalf, I ask my Republican colleagues who have majority rule of this Chamber, what are they going to do to stand up for American families and stop the billionaires who are dismantling Social Security? ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTH
statements.title: WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTH
sentences: Yet, the Republican majority is shoving a budget through that would gut Medicaid, which is the single largest payer of maternity care in our country, in order to give tax cuts to billionaires.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GIVE SENIORS THE CARE THEY DESERVE
statements.title: GIVE SENIORS THE CARE THEY DESERVE
sentences: He, like millions of seniors across the country, gets his nursing home coverage through Medicaid.
When I met Bob, he said he would not be here today were it not for Medicaid.

Now, congressional Republicans are proposing to gut Medicaid in order to pay for tax cuts for billionaires, which would mean less access to services, less access to care, and worse quality of life for seniors everywhere.
Remember, 62 percent of all nursing home residents in the United States are covered by Medicaid.
We cannot put our seniors' care on the chopping block to pay for tax cuts for billionaires.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "NATIONAL EMISSION STANDARDS FOR HAZARDOUS AIR POLL
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "NATIONAL EMISSION STANDARDS FOR HAZARDOUS AIR POLLUTANTS: RUBBER TIRE MANUFACTURING"
sentences: This resolution put forward by congressional Republicans would rip away protections that keep Americans safe from some of the most dangerous and cancer-causing air toxins in the world, such as arsenic and lead.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVAT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVATION PROGRAM: ENERGY CONSERVATION...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, today I rise on behalf of the nearly 80 million Americans across the country who get their health insurance through Medicaid.
Medicaid is the single largest source of healthcare coverage in the United States.
Medicaid covers nearly half of all children, and it is the largest insurer of kids with disabilities.
Medicaid is a vital source of prenatal and postpartum care for women, and it covers more than 40 percent of births in our country.
To make room for tax breaks for millionaires?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DOE AND SBA RESEARCH ACT
statements.title: DOE AND SBA RESEARCH ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 788, the DOE and SBA Research Act.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RURAL SMALL BUSINESS RESILIENCE ACT
statements.title: RURAL SMALL BUSINESS RESILIENCE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my legislation, H.R. 804, the Rural Small Business Resilience Act.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this legislation.
